Fill the tank up to the maximum pressure given in [Pressure limits]. Read the *whole* page _before_ you start.

{toc}

h1. Before you start

{info:title=Good to know}
The tank must be fully drained. See [the vendor site|https://example.com/hoses].
{info}

{warning:title=Crushing hazard}
Keep your fingers clear of the hose reel while it turns.
{warning}

h2. Steps

# Connect the hose to the tank inlet.
#* Check the inlet is clean.
# Open the valve slowly.
# Fill the tank to {{3 bar}} on the gauge.

!hose.png|alt=The hose connected to the tank inlet,width=50%!

h2. Reference

||Pressure||Hose||
|up to 3 bar|any|
|over 3 bar|-not allowed- without a pressure hose|
|over 4 bar|

{code:language=yaml|title=Settings}
max-pressure: 4
{code}
